expectations.text: B1: Coaches not dumps: gives a staged milestone plan / scaffold with TODOs, not a complete final implementation
expectations.evidence: Scaffold with TODOs, core left to learner: server.py handle_client raises NotImplementedError("M1: handle_client 还没实现 — 按上面的提示写"); agent: "accept 循环已写好，handle_client 留给你…你的工作在 handle_client"; README has staged milestone table M1–M7; PROGRESS.md only records "M0 骨架引导"; "当前进度：M1 / M7". Only M1 boilerplate written, M2+ untouched.

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Ends with concrete runnable checkpoint and expected output: "bash scripts/check_m1.sh  # 通过时输出: M1 通过: GET / 返回 HTTP 200"; check_m1.sh implements it (curl -w '%{http_code}', prints "M1 通过: GET / 返回 HTTP $code" or failure hints like "handle_client 实现了吗?").

expectations.text: B3: Technically specific to this tutorial (web-server-http): milestones match the tutorial's actual stages, language and key concepts, not generic boilerplate
expectations.evidence: Milestones match the joaoventura tutorial's actual stages and Python concepts: M1 TCP listener (socket、bind/listen/accept), M2 HTTP 解析 (请求行、头部、Content-Length body, 畸形请求→400), M3 静态文件 (MIME、404、路径穿越防护), M5 并发 (线程、keep-alive); server.py docstring cites "Building a basic HTTP Server from scratch in Python — joaoventura"; concept coaching is tutorial-specific ("状态行 + 头 + 空行 + body…连续两个 \r\n", recv/sendall/close steps), read per-tutorial skill web-server-http and its tutorial-map/concepts references.

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); asks the learner to install if needed
expectations.evidence: No install commands were run, but a command wrote outside the project dir: smoke test "python3 server.py 8080 > /tmp/srv.log 2>&1 &" (SHELL COMMANDS RUN #5) creates /tmp/srv.log outside the project; all other writes (tests/fixtures, __pycache__, scripts) stay inside.
